notes.title: First teaser for Dragon Shelter is OUT!
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

Today, we're excited to share with you the first trailer for Dragon Shelter!

[previewyoutube=OMwFg2Bz7LI;full][/previewyoutube]

In Dragon Shelter, you'll be transported to a magical world where humans and dragons are learning to live together once again. Your mission is to restore your grandfather's farm, befriend adorable dragons, and bring life to everything around you.

[b]What awaits you in Dragon Shelter:[/b]

🌱 You'll grow crops and restore the farm, turning it into a cozy haven where both dragons and humans can live in harmony.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/70a6b74f4e93ddc4ef5d3dc4ab8e154925c2c922.png[/img]

🐉 You’ll be able to befriend dragons! Each one has unique abilities that will help you in both exploration and farming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/abfee6ff02ce0e46147a00a9f18762df24ee6d17.png[/img]

🌳 We invite you to explore magical biomes, cleanse them from corruption, and restore their natural beauty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/8b8d78b4ced8ec2cc6f4684bdf910490837101b6.png[/img]

🏡 You can help the townsfolk overcome their struggles and rediscover happiness. Each character has a touching story, and only you can melt their hearts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/a1b9de31b45c9b018360e16e72c3e2b1945caa5b.png[/img]

For us, this game is more than just a farming simulator. We want you to experience how important it is to be friends, care for each other, and become part of something bigger. Dragon Shelter is a story about friendship, warmth, and building a world where you feel at home.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2712590/Dragon_Shelter

Dragon Shelter is an adorable farm-life game where you play as a young boy on a quest to rekindle the friendship between people and dragons. Restore an old farm, nurture your dragon pals, and explore a whimsical world filled with charm and wonder.

notes.title: Dev Diary #4: Friendship between Humans and Dragons
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today we're here to tell you more about farm life with dragons! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/93b5d116b73399e2868d3a7761710d456cde67e9.png[/img]

In present times, there's a lack of emotional warmth and tranquility, so we decided to create a small world of our own, to where people would like to return again and again. That's how the idea for Dragon Shelter appeared: a game about restoring an old farm and the neighboring town and reviving friendships and long-forgotten feelings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/a6011e7fde4d222ce86a0119fef15859bd75c10d.png[/img]

And for this role, we chose dragons, the magical creatures that deeply understand human emotions. Dragons are also adorable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/1e5cc18bb54c280d372694e8aa4e1444b1d9fd76.png[/img]

But the dragons in our game are not just cute, they are very intelligent and friendly, love to communicate, and often seek attention!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/d219ce9266156e7c1f18d1e29eb33581ee9df99a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/94bd5e16d945339075329f865190a1933700335b.gif[/img]

They are also very active, full of energy, and are happy to help our character with various household chores!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/3055d11fea20cc005e83b67e6536b2cf1d014a3b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/e62fc6204d7135d680f963a7a519271d7b4ff92d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/aa8e8fba4e5d17b5dabd5fbabf9f01ffb5c00e7f.gif[/img]

To make their help effective, they happily use their elements and unique abilities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/535d1bda379e62bad3424cda32f0082dd62eceae.gif[/img]

Each dragon on the farm has its own house. Here are the concept designs for the water dragon's house. Can you guess which one we chose?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/098e23b2aed40748fac9877e5ad4fe65a754f3ee.png[/img]

At first, we created the houses, but then it felt like the dragons wanted to live together with our character. So we're thinking of leaving the houses as treehouses for play, while they all sleep together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/73fc280d9f47b180baf9b5be5481b2b939df0c2c.gif[/img]

An overly affectionate dragon

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/1384122a0132da8bf8588aeb6e63f2df56a6e2e8.png[/img]

A dragon is asking for pats on head

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/5d3153b6bc9d60df9e9e6294a770ad94aad9b85e.png[/img]

A dragon travels with the main character and meets new friends

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/4b4136264b85ab4d094a605b89e41a20bf0af085.png[/img]

A dragon helps you to find the right path

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/0161a629f80cfc8b4abcfa651ba5e0fb00c9eae4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/db62c53a9ffd5c6d0f5bb7e15d861b24c715c4f0.jpg[/img]

I hope you enjoyed our dragons! Share your thoughts in the comments!

notes.title: Development Update | 26.02.24
notes.notes:
Hello Dragon Enthusiasts and Fantasy Friends!

In our Dev Diaries, we've whisked you away to the whimsical world of Dragon Shelter, introducing you to its adorable dragons and their magical habitat. Now, we're super excited to sprinkle some fairy dust on our updates and give you a peek into the heart of the game itself – and all the progress we’ve made! 🐉✨

Check out our first development update! Here’s what we have been doing for the last few months:

[h3]We have created the first playable build[/h3]

We are not yet ready to show it to the players, but the first build is ready! In this build, you can work on a farm and interact with dragons. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/70a6b74f4e93ddc4ef5d3dc4ab8e154925c2c922.png[/img]

This build features a variety of buildings you can explore on your farm, along with several charming dragons to meet and befriend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/abfee6ff02ce0e46147a00a9f18762df24ee6d17.png[/img]

And that's not all - the adventure extends beyond the farm; you can also step into the world of our main character by visiting their cozy house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/6ddbc7b7accf6360659566072d79c647504a6426.png[/img]

[h3]Crafting the Town and Its Inhabitants[/h3]

The next enchanting chapter in our build journey focuses on the town and its citizens! We've already laid the groundwork with detailed concepts for the town's design and its inhabitants. Currently, our creative energies are channeled into bringing these concepts to life through the development of 3D models.

Here’s our shopkeeper!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/16b18ce70df9ce9c0f81396f798d253dcf128168.png[/img]

And that’s what the city streets will look like! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/40161fb07dd673f535ee73550d4e52f80c28664b.png[/img]

[h3]We're Tuning the Soundscape![/h3]

Our team is joyfully weaving a magical tapestry of sounds to add an extra sprinkle of charm to our game's enchanting world. We're delighted to let you know that we've created a symphony of adorable soundtracks and lively sound effects (VFX), all designed to make the farm environment come alive with whimsy. Plus, we've lovingly crafted the main soundtrack, a musical hug that perfectly encapsulates the heartwarming adventure of our game!

[h3]Making Dragons into Delightful Helpers![/h3]

We're currently guiding our adorable dragons in learning basic activities, turning them into the most charming and helpful buddies.

The dragon is cutting a tree 🪓

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/0c1d6c6569ab30328be1459604098672373f575d.gif[/img]

The dragon is mining 💎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/7143199d19c57d9bfb73f1d5306e88bd8cb991e0.gif[/img]

The dragon is cooking 🥘

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/5c68c1eaedfc875c624447c9e1789aa0eaaf69e5.gif[/img]

[h3]Crafting Heartwarming Cutscenes[/h3]

In Dragon Shelter, we're weaving together cutscenes that are not just visually stunning but also brimming with emotion. These special moments are designed to capture the very soul of our game, enveloping players in a world where every scene is a heartfelt journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/28ee7f3dba6b40632dbe858cdda76acab839224e.gif[/img]

Our team is pouring love and creativity into these sequences, ensuring they resonate with the magical essence of the game and touch the hearts of our players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/d63bf280dfecfcda301cec9acf2b5005e0749ad1.gif[/img]

Thanks for Your Ongoing Support!

We're truly grateful for every bit of support. Stay tuned for more news about the game and its world. We appreciate you a lot! 🌟🐉💖

notes.title: Dev Diary #3 - The Water Dragon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/a7c8529f6bca27045b9694f7d8f1f1e2687e413e.png[/img]

Hello, everyone!

We are returning to tell you a bit more about our game and how things are going!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/8ded391545c10beed90d9dbaad447038c42b26d1.png[/img]

[h3]The Conflict[/h3]

In a once beautiful world, dragons and humans coexisted in friendship. Dragons always helped humans, and humans loved dragons. However, humans gave in to their darker traits, leading the dragons to leave the cities and abandon their friendship with humans.

After the cataclysm, both humans and cities fell into decay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/eb489dc66a7eeff78b8859eab949d41894bb768d.png[/img]

Many people became mired in sad memories and sorrows, closing themselves off from one another. But we believe our hero, along with the dragons, can find a way into their hardened hearts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/6c0b16b09b90b27a60102e33d6abbc6add1d4ad7.png[/img]

Much in the old city needs to be restored, and it must be done together with the dragons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/c5ba0e7724c6476e4fd20ba3981ed3e99223137c.png[/img]

Our hero, and you, will have to uncover what happened!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/d2bf2a9717fd860c64ee3af6f5a04a3d0553ac3a.gif[/img]

[h3]We continue working to convey the feelings of our beloved dragons and their unique qualities![/h3]

Meet the water dragon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/c1b31f55d3e4582899a319686b88309474b79877.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/9eb5ce5a4d286bf804642f12a9dfc72614f4d174.png[/img]

Isn't he just adorable?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/8ce9110765e0143f35219f883006345e48bd1a17.gif[/img]

He also loves to help in the kitchen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/a4aa358f329b5ad6a8c7a3a13312b3f4f09c0b26.png[/img]

And of course, like all dragons, he enjoys a tasty meal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/c1b31f55d3e4582899a319686b88309474b79877.png[/img]

He drank his fill and went to water the vegetable beds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/349ff379ddb995220f8a4c7c847932ab51e0bac6.gif[/img]

We also want to show you a bit of our work on lighting. We're still adjusting it, and it's far from perfect, but we're trying our best!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/417abe09919b888725fab7798aac07d2c4561779.gif[/img]

In the upcoming posts, we will share more info about the dragons, the townsfolk and the main character. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 - Emotional Component
notes.notes:
✨Hi, everyone! 

Today’s dev diary will be dedicated to the emotions and the visual aspect that we've been diligently crafting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/699940840a24a378177c2b6ced457e29377aba43.png[/img]

[h3]Primary Emotions[/h3]

Friendship, reunion, the significance of understanding others' feelings, tenderness, care, and collaboration.

We have a strong desire for everything to become peaceful. To unite people with joy, love, and coziness.

One of the main feelings in our game is unity, and reunification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/df9f3cc3e52525ce472dc7b70aa00de78c396f9d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/6bd83056dda046ba8bf75cf1e9c9ba483bdbc86a.png[/img]

The world of Dragon Shelter, where our hero resides, has been left fractured after a great cataclysm that tore apart the world of humans, creatures, and dragons.

[h3]Emotions of a main character[/h3]

Perhaps, some of you have had a garden, where you would work with your grandmother or parents. It's a sunny morning in summer, with sunlight filtering through the trees, butterflies fluttering about, and a sense of peace in your heart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/1f5212dce5e40fed1641c92f8e22e80e675faae7.png[/img]

So here's our hero—a young man who wants to fix everything, set things right, roll up his sleeves, and help everyone. We want the player to feel like a unifier of the world and a friendship-builder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/4ff0ded76c96ba9605b6b1fa391b6c72410494ed.png[/img]

The most important thing for our hero is to be a generous and caring friend, someone who believes that through teamwork, communication, and assistance, we can overcome old grievances and learn to be friends. He does all of this because of his strong empathy, so as not to feel the pain of other beings around him.

He feels a sense of responsibility and surprise when he discovers a dragon egg about to hatch. He realizes his crucial role and feels responsible for the well-being of the dragons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/a2cae62e692dbaac91b424715ad42240a6baba88.png[/img]

The player's first task is to feed the dragon. Our hero spots some old tools—a scythe, a shovel, and an axe—that will help him with this task.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/1ad6de60b05c25bc19a7f6b488726fb389151ebb.gif[/img]

He needs to chop wood, prepare soup, and give the dragon his food.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/71870ab1e40773b75ee6ef33b54efa09a82a4f07.gif[/img]

All animations and some graphics are still prototypes to get closer to the desired style, so please don't be too strict (for now)).

[h3]Emotions of the Dragons[/h3]

Dragons are creatures that are incapable of lying, or being hypocritical, and possess an extremely subtle sense of the world and the surrounding mood and emotions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/f6fbda031941984d23486c4495b56aa16426e80d.png[/img]

In their hearts, they are playful and mischievous. Due to their nature, they can be slightly aggressive.

Because of the global conflict, they have changed significantly, but we will tell you more about it in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/d4921cf704a4b2f175c0299493c9e61e13c1fda8.png[/img]

The dragons are highly empathetic and curious about the world around them and other creatures.

They aspire to help and support others, to study and understand their feelings, as well as to show compassion and aid in healing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/7d3f5a820703c4a2239b579638cfb297d3ba0be1.png[/img]

Dragons, in terms of their emotions, are in a stage akin to young adults. They are intelligent, full of enthusiasm and joy. Each dragon expresses their feelings and emotions uniquely, depending on their individuality and character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/8c2e130bb68932ca24ca39b0260058e3fb81f89f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/43366c2d31f2a343389db92f47bf627efbb84fd5.gif[/img]

And this is a part of the development idea for the dusty dragon and the woody one. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/04cf7024932f2cca739e538173c8e9ee940e3d51.png[/img]

[h3]Teaching the Dragons[/h3]

One of the core mechanics in the game will revolve around teaching the dragons. As mentioned earlier, dragons have a strong interest in the world around them, and in the previous post, we showed that they can adorn themselves with various items, get into places they shouldn't, and basically do what dragons like - being dragons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/c06c45a1f1432a971882f7188ec0e9b44a2e30c5.png[/img]

Therefore, the hero must help the dragon understand what's good and what's not so good. While dragons may have their own willfulness, for the sake of the common good, learning is essential (not all dragons can get along with each other).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/530e29be999580828ef1cf583cc7f325a15c026e.png[/img]

In the upcoming posts, we will showcase some mechanics and share insights into the feelings of other creatures in our cozy yet complex world. Stay tuned! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2712590/Dragon_Shelter

Dragon Shelter is an adorable farm-life game where you play as a young boy on a quest to rekindle the friendship between people and dragons. Restore an old farm, nurture your dragon pals, and explore a whimsical world filled with charm and wonder.

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 - Concept and Inspiration
notes.notes:
✨Hey, everyone! 

Today we’ll tell you a bit more about the amazing world of Dragon Shelter, where you’ll have to rebuild your farm with the help of cute little dragons. 

Dragon Shelter is a single-player farm-life sim developed for PC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/fa128a6a089fee2bd43b787fa5187583134a4759.png[/img]

Our primary inspiration for the art style comes from the worlds crafted by Ghibli. We are developing a distinctive visual style centered around watercolors and the ambiance found in Miyazaki's realms. With this approach, we aim to capture the emotions and sentiments of both characters and dragons, ultimately crafting a unique atmosphere that will captivate you from the very first moments of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/23fd50d0ea19647cefa62dae1b626f19b8970be8.png[/img]

The concept of my game revolves around assisting dragons and rejuvenating both an aged farm and an adjacent city.

Here, I'm sharing my journey of exploring various art styles for the buildings:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/1678603478defb9a0b49da77aad941cbf507222a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/982162eda43616feb3ab53fd412e425aee0e3582.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/fb5ebe7bcfada842d4f3d741635aed4e1a905bd0.png[/img]

And dragons. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/ed262a9e1ec6a001b28f0f02b245384f57c86e31.png[/img]

All dragons have different elements, and consequently, diverse personalities and behaviors.

Here the dragon is studying an item, and it looks like he likes it as a bed. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/a3c1c33a61e2871aeba38bc7c1c4ab217707f1ee.png[/img]

Surprised by a fish

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/c7f1f6c14719465a09340b4a9e4233d7f45b7ee3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/9be9847e281bd188af2dcd70471ceeaa07b90750.png[/img]

We aim to create an engaging system for player-dragon interaction where dragons respond to what players teach them. Here's how it works:

[list]
[*] Dragons can equip various items.
[*] However, the chosen item must align with the dragon's preferences.
[*] These preferences are influenced by the dragon's character and their current activities.
[*] Players have the power to shape the dragon's personality and preferences through their interactions.
[/list]

I've included a brief prototype below, demonstrating dragons picking up and adorning themselves with assorted items from the farm. Please keep in mind that it's still a prototype and does not showcase the final art style. However, it does convey the core concept. The art style is expected to resemble the images provided below (or at least I'm optimistic it will).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/9582fe771a86d0df1af358653c9d3d98a5ca1a13.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/f8f22367fd645a64931f496b443c277c6bce5cd2.png[/img]

In the upcoming Devlogs, we will delve deeper into the intricacies of Dragon Shelter, from the magical ecosystems that surround you to the heartwarming stories of the dragons that will become your cherished companions. We'll also keep you updated on our development progress and provide insight into the mechanics and features that will make Dragon Shelter a truly extraordinary experience. Stay tuned for more updates!
